text: so how do you generate it ? i see how to import, and how to text prompt, what about image prompt
resolution: Answered how to generate from an image and wired the convenience the user asked for. Image input is the SAME command with a file path: tools/genmodel ./pic.png (or tools/genprop ./pic.png --kind ...) — auto-detected as image when the first arg is an existing file; image-only (Shap-E img2img), no combined text+image mode. Added root-level shims tools/genmodel and tools/genprop that exec the real cart/hmsc-int/tools/ scripts, so the short 'tools/genmodel ...' I'd been quoting actually resolves from repo root like rjit/v8cli (verified: no-arg prints the real usage). Also clarified (req_1408/1409): with an image you provide NO text prompt, and you do NOT need a transparent cutout — the pipeline auto-runs rembg (u2net) to strip the background and composite on white, with --no-rembg to skip for already-clean/transparent inputs. Committed 9e4727843. Standing caveat reiterated: Shap-E img2img collapses depth (flat results); SF3D/Hunyuan is the image->3D quality upgrade still on offer.
